description: List Agents. Lists all active agents for the specified location. locationId is required parameter to ensure optimal performance. Supports pagination using limit and offset. Optionally filter by isPublished=true to return only agents with a published production version.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_agentStudio_listAgents
